card.title: Make Them Your Deputy
card.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You'll sell the tickets; I'll decide when we draw. One clear chain of command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ticket queue is already round the hall. Come help me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll stand beside you and authorise extra ticket sellers. You can start recruiting them.
